name: net.visualcon/rivus-mcp
title: XRPL banking data (pay per call in XRP or RLUSD)
description: XRPL banking data: corridor cost, issuer due diligence, screening. Pay per call in XRP or RLUSD.

tools.name: corridor_quote
tools.description: Real cost of moving value between two XRPL assets at a given size. Use when: You need to know how much arrives (or how much to send) when paying across XRPL assets: effective rate versus mid, slippage at size, issuer transfer fee, AMM fee, network fee and the route taken. Price: 0.005 RLUSD per call, or the equivalent in XRP, paid on the XRP Ledger with x402 (the first call returns the payment requirements).

tools.name: issuer_profile
tools.description: Technical due diligence of a token issuer account. Use when: Before holding or accepting an issued token: can the issuer freeze or claw back, does it charge a transfer fee, is its domain verified, how much is outstanding and how many holders it has. Price: 0.005 RLUSD per call, or the equivalent in XRP, paid on the XRP Ledger with x402 (the first call returns the payment requirements).

tools.name: issuer_monitor
tools.description: Change log and supply/holder history of a stablecoin or token issuer covered by periodic capture. Use when: You hold or accept a stablecoin/IOU and want to know what changed at its issuer over time: flag changes (freeze, clawback, auth), transfer fee and domain changes, issued supply and holder count history. Only issuers covered by the periodic capture; others are rejected before payment. Price: 0.005 RLUSD per call, or the equivalent in XRP, paid on the XRP Ledger with x402 (the first call returns the payment requirements).

tools.name: account_screen
tools.description: Technical screening of an XRPL account before sending to it. Use when: Before paying an account: whether it exists, requires a destination tag, blocks incoming payments, is blackholed or multisigned, and how active it has been. Price: 0.005 RLUSD per call, or the equivalent in XRP, paid on the XRP Ledger with x402 (the first call returns the payment requirements).

tools.name: dex_liquidity_profile
tools.description: Order book liquidity profile of a token/XRP pair. Use when: You need depth near the mid, the spread, the bid/ask imbalance and where the liquidity walls are. Price: 0.003 RLUSD per call, or the equivalent in XRP, paid on the XRP Ledger with x402 (the first call returns the payment requirements).

tools.name: market_chart
tools.description: Price history of a pair as a PNG chart or as JSON points. Use when: You want the recent price series of a pair, to plot it or to read highs, lows and change. Price: 0.001 RLUSD per call, or the equivalent in XRP, paid on the XRP Ledger with x402 (the first call returns the payment requirements).

tools.name: market_ohlc
tools.description: OHLC candles of the mid price of a pair, with data gaps and coverage reported. Use when: You need candles (open, high, low, close per interval) of an XRPL DEX pair for indicators or backtests. Candles are built from 5-minute mid-price samples; gaps are reported, never filled. Price: 0.001 RLUSD per call, or the equivalent in XRP, paid on the XRP Ledger with x402 (the first call returns the payment requirements).

tools.name: forecast_price_path
tools.description: Calibrated one-hour price range (±1σ cone) for a pair. Use when: You need a calibrated range for where the price is likely to be within the next hour, with its measured coverage. It is a range, not a direction. Price: 0.01 RLUSD per call, or the equivalent in XRP, paid on the XRP Ledger with x402 (the first call returns the payment requirements).

tools.name: forecast_track_record
tools.description: Measured calibration of the price range forecaster. Free. Use when: Before buying forecast.price_path: how often the price actually ended inside the published range. Free.

tools.name: tx_cost_plan
tools.description: Fees and reserve an XRPL transaction plan will cost, and whether an account can afford it. Use when: Before executing a set of XRPL transactions (trust lines, offers, escrows, checks, AMM deposit or create, payments, account deletion): how much XRP goes to fees and how much gets locked as reserve. Pass address to check whether that account's free balance covers it. Price: 0.002 RLUSD per call, or the equivalent in XRP, paid on the XRP Ledger with x402 (the first call returns the payment requirements).

tools.name: network_health
tools.description: Current XRP Ledger health: ledger age, fees, load and reserves. Free. Use when: Before submitting a transaction: is the network validating, what fee to use, what the reserves are. Free.
